## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Tests

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
- [ ] New or updated tests use synthetic data.

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens or private data are included.
- [ ] No third-party content is added.
- [ ] The core remains dependency-free (optional integrations are opt-in).
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
